subject: Post-demo recap: target $/1M benchmarks + next steps
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@clearhealth.ai>, Adam Lee <adam.lee@clearhealth.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2028 16:42:00 +0000
Subject: Post-demo recap: target $/1M benchmarks + next steps

Thanks again for the demo time today — great conversation, Sophie and Adam. Quick recap from our side and a couple of asks so we can return a tailored commercial pilot proposal.

Key takeaways from the call:
- Primary workload: anonymized clinical summarization + conversational triage (short responses but high QPS spikes).
- Expected ramp: 20M–60M tokens/month in months 1–6, potential to 150M+/mo in year 1 if clinical pilot expands.
- Current hosts in evaluation: Anthropic for safety review, OpenAI for general generation; looking for a lower-cost serving option with parity on latency and a clear plan for hallucination/QA.

Two asks so we can put together a clear $/1M benchmarking view vs your current hosts:
1) Confirm the target budget range you have in mind for a production pilot (ballpark $/1M is fine).
2) Are there non-negotiable terms we should account for (data residency, SOC2 evidence, or retention limits)?

What we’ll provide next by EOD Monday:
- A concise comparison table ($/1M tokens) vs OpenAI/Anthropic and one common open-host scenario.
- A proposed 90-day pilot commercial with commit levels, blunt price points, and failure modes (Eg: burst tolerance, fallback routing to Anthropic).

I attached a short comps CSV and a draft mutual action plan template for review — please consider these as starting points.

Next steps:
- Sophie — if you can confirm a target $/1M budget bracket (even rough), we’ll lock a recommended pilot price and the guardrails.
- Ben — will pull together a quick internal cost model and comp table for the pilot options.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.inference
Attachments: redwood_1M_comps_20280614.csv (spreadsheet), clearhealth_ma_plan_v1.pdf (PDF)

From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@clearhealth.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference>
Cc: Adam Lee <adam.lee@clearhealth.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 Jun 2028 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap: target $/1M benchmarks + next steps

Thanks Jasmine — good framing. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Volume confirmation: the 20M–60M/mo is accurate for the pilot phase. If the initial pilot hits success criteria, we expect a fast ramp to ~120–160M/mo inside 9–12 months.
- Budget target: we’re aiming for unit economics in the range of $10–$16 per 1M tokens for the pilot. That’s the sweet spot to make tooling + human review economically viable for the product team.
- Must-haves: SOC2 in place (or timeline to complete), EU data residency is not required for this pilot (US-first), and we need token-level billing granularity for cost attribution.

We’re comfortable evaluating a short-term premium if there’s a clear path to the low end of that $/1M range as volumes scale. Also open to a hybrid routing approach if you can show deterministic fallback behavior.

Sophie Turner
Head of Product, ClearHealth
sophie.turner@clearhealth.ai

Date: Sat, 15 Jun 2028 17:00:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo recap: target $/1M benchmarks + next steps

Looping you in, Laura — quick internal note after Sophie’s reply:

- ClearHealth pilot volume: 20–60M/mo initial, target $10–$16/1M (they explicitly called this their budget band).
- Must-haves: SOC2 or timeline to SOC2, token-level billing, US-only for pilot.

Action items I suggest:
- Engineering (through you, Jasmine): confirm whether we can provide token-granular billing exports and a simple retention policy for the pilot (14–30 days recommended).
- Pricing: propose two pilot price points we can operationalize quickly: (A) $15/1M with no commit but 30-day opt-out; (B) $12/1M with a 90-day minimum commit at 40M/mo average (volume ramp clause). Include clear overage math.
- Comps: I ran a quick skeleton — OpenAI gpt-4 style hosts land ~ $60–$120/1M for similar throughput patterns; Anthropic looks ~ $45–$90/1M depending on context windows. Our open-host (quantized) baseline can be presented at $8–$20/1M depending on config.

I’ll drop a cleaned comps CSV and a short justification memo for the two price points. If legal needs to be looped earlier for pilot contract language, say so.

-Ben

Subject: Re: Post-demo recap: target $/1M benchmarks + next steps

Sophie — appreciate the quick clarity. Attaching the cleaned price-comps and a short pilot proposal (PDF + CSV). Summary below for convenience: 

Snapshot: $/1M token comps (summary)
- Redwood (pilot A - no commit): $15 / 1M tokens — 30-day rolling, full streaming, token-billing export (CSV).
- Redwood (pilot B - committed): $12 / 1M tokens — 90-day minimum, target 40M/mo average, 25% credits on overage if average >= committed volume.
- OpenAI (public pricing proxy): ~ $60–$90 / 1M tokens (varies by model & context window).
- Anthropic (public proxy): ~ $45–$80 / 1M tokens for similar safety-tuned flows.
- Open-host (quantized): $8–$20 / 1M tokens depending on quantization + latency tradeoffs.

Notes:
- Important to call out: our ‘open-host’ numbers assume aggressive quantization and a small-attention optimized runtime; we’ll validate latency at your expected QPS during the pilot.
- Pilot terms in attached PDF cover data handling, SOC2 roadmap, billing exports, and a basic SLA for latency percentile targets.

Next steps:
1) Sophie — confirm whether Pilot A or B is preferable. If Pilot B, please confirm expected committed avg (we assumed 40M/mo).
2) Adam — if you want legal early, I can send a short pilot SOW and DocuSign link.
3) Ben & Laura — please prep a two-slide internal ROI summary showing cost gap vs Anthropic at 40M and 120M mo for exec review.

Links and attachments:
- Pilot SOW (DocuSign): https://app.docusign.com/signon/start?env=demo&id=cle-4582-sow
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2B3Cclearhealth-demo-notes
- Attachments: redwood_1M_comps_20280614.csv, clearhealth_ma_plan_v1.pdf

Thanks — happy to hop on a short alignment call tomorrow if helpful.

Best,
